target_customer: Enterprises verifying education, employment and loyalty data of users
problem: Document-upload verification has poor conversion and privacy/liability risk.
business_model: B2B usage-based verification API (per-verification pricing not stated; company says cost under $1)

founders.name: Sriharsha Karamchati
founders.background_notes: Works on zkTLS, verifiable AI sessions, agent authentication; building Popcorn.

technical_complexity.rationale: Cryptographic proofs of data from websites (zkTLS) without exposing user data is specialized work, though sources give no detail for 2021.

defensibility.rationale: Cryptographic approach and global coverage claims are harder to copy than a document-upload flow; no patents or exclusive access evidenced.

market_need_then: YC page claims 45%+ conversion versus document uploads; no 2021-dated demand data gathered.
outcome_analysis: Reclaim Protocol is active with 17 staff and states $10M raised in a Series A, while a May 2022 $8.3M Series A led by Lemniscap was reported under the name Questbook, which one aggregator links to Reclaim. The identity link and the $10M versus $8.3M gap are unreconciled, so the funding story is uncertain and no outcome has occurred yet.
notes: Seedtable (403 on fetch, seen only in search snippet) assigns Questbook's Series A to Reclaim Protocol; a company rename or pivot from web3 grants is unconfirmed and no pivot recorded. YC description says $10M total (Series A). Competitors not evidenced.
